- 竺法護 (A000749)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle Western-Jìn translation by Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 of the *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā* — the same Indic source as *[Fàngguāng bōrě jīng (T221)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0002)* but in an earlier, partial Chinese rendering. Signature: 「西晉三藏竺法護譯」. Taishō header cross-references [T220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0001)(2), [T221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0002), and [T223](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0004). Only the first 27 chapters of the *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā* survive in T222 — the rest was either never translated or was lost in transmission.

**Abstract**

T222's translation is documented in the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* to Tàikāng 太康 7 = 286 CE at Cháng'ān, five years before T221. T222 is therefore the earliest surviving Chinese translation of the *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā*, predating T221 by some five years; it is, however, the textually less complete of the two. Modern scholarship (Mochizuki; Lamotte) treats T222 as Dharmarakṣa's first attempt at the *Prajñāpāramitā*, undertaken before the more extensive Mokṣala / [竺叔蘭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E5%8F%94%E8%98%AD) Zhú Shūlán project produced T221 in 291.

The *Guāngzàn* ("Light-Praise") title-element refers to the same opening *prajñāpāramitā*-light-emission *nidāna* as T221's *Fàngguāng* ("Light-Emitting"); the difference reflects translation idiom, not a different Indic source. Both T222 and T221 work from closely related Sanskrit *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā* recensions.
